Hey fellow Voat devs - just wanted to make a quick announcement that Voatify for iOS has been approved! Here is my initial post that gives a rundown of the basic features 1.0 will be launching with.

In that submission, a few people raised concerns that Apple might reject it due to the content on Voat like it did to Gab. And actually, it did get rejected! Here was the message sent by Apple the first time around:

Your app enables the display of user-generated content but does not have the required precautions in place.

Specifically, it would be appropriate to include a reporting/flagging mechanism for potentially inappropriate posts.

Next Steps

Please revise your app to implement all of the following precautions:

  • Require that users agree to terms (EULA) and these terms must make it clear that there is no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users
  • A method for filtering objectionable content
  • A mechanism for users to flag objectionable content
  • A mechanism for users to block abusive users
  • The developer must act on objectionable content reports within 24 hours by removing the content and ejecting the user who provided the offending content

I ended up addressing everything (under the Filter section) except the EULA because Voatify does not allow the user to interact yet. Also, obviously ejecting a user from Voat is not really how the community works, so I gave a popup to say that a reported submission would be reviewed if they clicked "Report." I believe Apple just wants all their bases covered in case someone complains, and at least a message showing concern like that would allow them to say objectionable content is addressed. Anyway, my second submission seemed to satisfy them. Seeing this app pass Apple's review gives me hope that Gab will also pass, because the message they gave to me feels very similar to what they rejected Gab for.

I wanted make a formal announcement to the rest of Voat on Monday Jan 16, 2017 which is MLK day. But since it takes the app 24 hrs to process on the app store, I will make it available by Sunday night on the 15th, so that it will be ready in all regions when I announce it the following day.
